import pandas as pd

def main():
    # File paths for all sources
    path_source_0 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_0.csv"
    path_source_1 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_1.csv"
    path_source_2 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_2.csv"
    path_source_3 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_3.csv"
    path_source_4 = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/test_4.csv"
    path_target = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"

    # Load all source tables
    df_causa = pd.read_csv(path_source_0)
    df_deteccion = pd.read_csv(path_source_1)
    df_main = pd.read_csv(path_source_2)
    df_actividad = pd.read_csv(path_source_3)
    df_factor = pd.read_csv(path_source_4)

    # Inspect and drop any unnamed index columns if present (common when saving/loading CSVs)
    for df in [df_causa, df_deteccion, df_main, df_actividad, df_factor]:
        unnamed_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col.startswith("Unnamed")]
        if unnamed_cols:
            df.drop(columns=unnamed_cols, inplace=True)

    # Merge df_main with df_causa on 'Causa' to get IdCausa
    # But df_main already has 'Causa' as string and df_causa has IdCausa and Causa.
    # We want to get IdCausa from df_causa by matching 'Causa' string.
    # However, df_main already has a 'Causa' column (string) and df_causa has IdCausa and Causa.
    # So merge on 'Causa' to get IdCausa.
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_causa, on='Causa', how='left')

    # Merge df_main with df_deteccion on 'Deteccion' to get IdDeteccion
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_deteccion, on='Deteccion', how='left')

    # Merge df_main with df_actividad on 'Actividad' to get IdActividad
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_actividad, on='Actividad', how='left')

    # Merge df_main with df_factor on 'Factor' to get IdFactor
    df_main = df_main.merge(df_factor, on='Factor', how='left')

    # After merges, df_main should have all Id columns:
    # IdCausa, IdDeteccion, IdActividad, IdFactor

    # The target schema requires these columns in this order:
    target_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'IdAhogado', 'IdPersona', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora',
        'Latitud_inc', 'Longitud_inc', 'Sexo', 'Edad', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen', 'Extraccion',
        'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico', 'Localizacion',
        'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion', 'ID', 'Estacion',
        'Estado', 'Latitud_est', 'Longitud_est', 'T_med', 'T_max', 'T_min', 'Presion',
        'Dir. vi.', 'V_Viento', 'Nubosidad', 'ProfNievecm', 'InsolacHoras', 'Distancia',
        'IdActividad', 'IdCausa', 'IdDeteccion', 'IdFactor'
    ]

    # Note: Source df_main has a column 'Precipitaciones' which is NOT in target schema, so drop it if present
    if 'Precipitaciones' in df_main.columns:
        df_main.drop(columns=['Precipitaciones'], inplace=True)

    # Check if all target columns exist in df_main after merges
    missing_cols = [col for col in target_columns if col not in df_main.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing columns after merge: {missing_cols}")

    # Reorder columns to target schema
    df_target = df_main[target_columns]

    # Convert data types according to target schema:
    # 'Fecha': string (keep as is)
    # 'IdAhogado': integer
    # 'IdPersona': integer
    # 'Localidad': string
    # 'Provincia': string
    # 'CCAA': string
    # 'Hora': string
    # 'Latitud_inc': float
    # 'Longitud_inc': float
    # 'Sexo': string
    # 'Edad': float
    # 'Nacionalidad': string
    # 'Origen': string
    # 'Extraccion': string
    # 'Causa': string
    # 'TipoAhogamiento': string
    # 'Factor': string
    # 'Intervencion': string
    # 'Pronostico': string
    # 'Localizacion': string
    # 'Riesgo': string
    # 'Reanimacion': string
    # 'Vigilancia': string
    # 'Actividad': string
    # 'Deteccion': string
    # 'ID': integer
    # 'Estacion': string
    # 'Estado': string
    # 'Latitud_est': float
    # 'Longitud_est': float
    # 'T_med': float
    # 'T_max': float
    # 'T_min': float
    # 'Presion': float
    # 'Dir. vi.': float
    # 'V_Viento': integer
    # 'Nubosidad': float
    # 'ProfNievecm': float
    # 'InsolacHoras': float
    # 'Distancia': float
    # 'IdActividad': integer
    # 'IdCausa': integer
    # 'IdDeteccion': integer
    # 'IdFactor': integer

    # Define dtype conversions with errors='coerce' for safety
    dtype_conversions = {
        'IdAhogado': 'Int64',
        'IdPersona': 'Int64',
        'Edad': 'float',
        'Latitud_inc': 'float',
        'Longitud_inc': 'float',
        'Latitud_est': 'float',
        'Longitud_est': 'float',
        'T_med': 'float',
        'T_max': 'float',
        'T_min': 'float',
        'Presion': 'float',
        'Dir. vi.': 'float',
        'V_Viento': 'Int64',
        'Nubosidad': 'float',
        'ProfNievecm': 'float',
        'InsolacHoras': 'float',
        'Distancia': 'float',
        'IdActividad': 'Int64',
        'IdCausa': 'Int64',
        'IdDeteccion': 'Int64',
        'IdFactor': 'Int64',
        'ID': 'Int64'
    }

    for col, dtype in dtype_conversions.items():
        if col in df_target.columns:
            if dtype == 'Int64':
                # pandas nullable integer type
                df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
            else:
                df_target[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_target[col], errors='coerce')

    # For string columns, ensure they are string type (object)
    string_columns = [
        'Fecha', 'Localidad', 'Provincia', 'CCAA', 'Hora', 'Sexo', 'Nacionalidad', 'Origen',
        'Extraccion', 'Causa', 'TipoAhogamiento', 'Factor', 'Intervencion', 'Pronostico',
        'Localizacion', 'Riesgo', 'Reanimacion', 'Vigilancia', 'Actividad', 'Deteccion',
        'Estacion', 'Estado'
    ]
    for col in string_columns:
        if col in df_target.columns:
            df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype(str).replace('nan', '')

    # Save the final dataframe to CSV
    df_target.to_csv(path_target, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
